The office toolkit is installed at the same path without its deck template library, so the family phase writes each family's deck with PptxGenJS by the office-pptx skill instead of searching that library. The office-docx and office-xlsx skills it names were not in the source catalog either.

The office toolkit ships without its deck template library and `office pptx search-templates`, so the "Use a template" section is gone. Its run, repair and check step stays as "Run, repair, and look", and new decks come from the PptxGenJS section.
